info.title: Scan & Dine API Contract
info.description: Unified OpenAPI Specification for Scan & Dine SaaS Platform. Bridges TypeScript microservices with web frontends, Flutter mobile apps, and kitchen KDS.

put.description: Only documented editable fields are accepted. Unknown fields, venueId, deletedAt, timestamps and MongoDB operators are rejected. Nested updates preserve unspecified sibling fields. usage.currentUses is server-managed. A discount update requires type and value; percentage discounts cannot exceed 100.

get.description: Business staff management only. VENUE_ADMIN can manage MANAGER, CASHIER, WAITER and KITCHEN_STAFF. MANAGER can manage only CASHIER, WAITER and KITCHEN_STAFF. Neither role can create, modify or deactivate VENUE_ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN accounts. SUPER_ADMIN tokens are rejected by this server. Staff responses exclude passwordHash, pinCodeHash and twoFactorSecret.
